user.title: DAC – Dynamic Alarm Clock
user.description: No input is required. After adding the integration you will find every setting in the sidebar panel “DAC”.

data.default_alarm_time: Default alarm time (fallback when no work time is set)
data.offset_minutes: Offset: minutes to wake up BEFORE work starts
data.reminder_time: Daily reminder at (checks whether a work time was set)
data.alexa_enabled: Also set an Alexa device alarm (Echo)
data.pre_alarm_minutes: Pre-alarm on the Echo: minutes before the wake-up time
data.alexa_command_type: Alexa command type (custom = text command, tts = spoken)

set_work_time.name: Set work time
set_work_time.description: Sets the work start and derives the wake-up time from it (work start minus offset).

dismiss_for_today.name: Dismiss for today
dismiss_for_today.description: Disables the alarm for the current or upcoming day.

set_alexa_alarm.name: Sync Alexa alarm
set_alexa_alarm.description: Also sets the calculated alarm as a real Echo alarm (text command with morning/evening).

clear_alexa_alarm.name: Clear Alexa alarm (DAC's own only)
clear_alexa_alarm.description: Deletes exactly the Echo alarm set by DAC – manually created Alexa alarms stay untouched.
